purpose: Hash the active v2 source snapshot, module dossiers, release metadata, and sanitized evidence into a reproducible Merkle manifest.
invariants: MERKLE-MANIFEST.json is excluded from its own leaf set.
Line endings are normalized before content hashing.
All active module dossiers must declare version v2.
Artifact ordering is ordinal and stable.

determinism.replayContract: Unchanged source and release files reproduce the same artifact hashes and release Merkle root.

securityAndPrivacy: Only repository source and sanitized release evidence are hashed
limitations: The manifest binds the working-tree snapshot, not a clean signed Git commit.
verification: Two consecutive generations must produce the same release Merkle root.
